fact_text: Sazgar Engineering assembles rickshaws and cars and exports its rickshaws to Japan.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SAZGAR ROE Analysis Reveals the SECRET to MAXIMIZING Return on Equity | Afaque Manzar | #psx' (YouTube, 2025-02-12)

fact_text: Return on equity (ROE) equals net income divided by shareholders' equity, multiplied by 100 to give a percentage.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SAZGAR ROE Analysis Reveals the SECRET to MAXIMIZING Return on Equity | Afaque Manzar | #psx' (YouTube, 2025-02-12)

fact_text: Illustration: a company with 1000 crore of shareholders' equity that earns 200 crore of profit in a year has a 20% ROE.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SAZGAR ROE Analysis Reveals the SECRET to MAXIMIZING Return on Equity | Afaque Manzar | #psx' (YouTube, 2025-02-12)

fact_text: ROE uses only shareholders' equity and ignores debt, so a company funded by heavy borrowing can show a high ROE that misleads; check debt-to-equity alongside it.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SAZGAR ROE Analysis Reveals the SECRET to MAXIMIZING Return on Equity | Afaque Manzar | #psx' (YouTube, 2025-02-12)

fact_text: In a hypothetical example, a company with some debt on top of its equity earns about a 40% ROE, showing how borrowing can inflate the ratio.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SAZGAR ROE Analysis Reveals the SECRET to MAXIMIZING Return on Equity | Afaque Manzar | #psx' (YouTube, 2025-02-12)

fact_text: Return on investment (ROI) equals the gain from an investment divided by its cost, multiplied by 100; it applies to instruments such as gold or deposits, not to company shareholding.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SAZGAR ROE Analysis Reveals the SECRET to MAXIMIZING Return on Equity | Afaque Manzar | #psx' (YouTube, 2025-02-12)

fact_text: The analyst suggests ROI suits short-term trading and ROE suits long-term holding of a company, so an investor should look at both ratios.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SAZGAR ROE Analysis Reveals the SECRET to MAXIMIZING Return on Equity | Afaque Manzar | #psx' (YouTube, 2025-02-12)

fact_text: Other comprehensive income, such as gains or losses from investments outside the core business, sits outside net profit, so ROE should use net income after adjusting for it.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SAZGAR ROE Analysis Reveals the SECRET to MAXIMIZING Return on Equity | Afaque Manzar | #psx' (YouTube, 2025-02-12)

fact_text: Sazgar's shareholders' equity in its 2024 balance sheet was about 1010 crore.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SAZGAR ROE Analysis Reveals the SECRET to MAXIMIZING Return on Equity | Afaque Manzar | #psx' (YouTube, 2025-02-12)

fact_text: Sazgar reported a net profit of about 793 crore for 2024, with a separate 2 crore other-comprehensive-income loss that lowers net income to about 791 crore.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SAZGAR ROE Analysis Reveals the SECRET to MAXIMIZING Return on Equity | Afaque Manzar | #psx' (YouTube, 2025-02-12)

fact_text: Using net income of about 791 crore against equity of about 1010 crore gives Sazgar an ROE of roughly 78% for 2024.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SAZGAR ROE Analysis Reveals the SECRET to MAXIMIZING Return on Equity | Afaque Manzar | #psx' (YouTube, 2025-02-12)

fact_text: Companies park idle cash in other investments, and returns from them are booked in other comprehensive income rather than net profit, which can mislead investors about core earnings.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SAZGAR ROE Analysis Reveals the SECRET to MAXIMIZING Return on Equity | Afaque Manzar | #psx' (YouTube, 2025-02-12)

fact_text: A share's book value is based on the company's accounts and can be far below its market price; buying at a market premium means the extra paid is not backed by book equity.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SAZGAR ROE Analysis Reveals the SECRET to MAXIMIZING Return on Equity | Afaque Manzar | #psx' (YouTube, 2025-02-12)

fact_text: Shareholders bear a company's profits and losses through book value: a declared loss is deducted from retained earnings and book value, not from the investor's share price directly.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SAZGAR ROE Analysis Reveals the SECRET to MAXIMIZING Return on Equity | Afaque Manzar | #psx' (YouTube, 2025-02-12)

fact_text: Profit a company does not pay out as dividend is kept as retained earnings, which adds to its book value per share.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SAZGAR ROE Analysis Reveals the SECRET to MAXIMIZING Return on Equity | Afaque Manzar | #psx' (YouTube, 2025-02-12)

fact_text: Sustained losses erode shareholder equity; the analyst says that if a loss-making company keeps losing money, shareholders' capital could reach zero within about five years.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SAZGAR ROE Analysis Reveals the SECRET to MAXIMIZING Return on Equity | Afaque Manzar | #psx' (YouTube, 2025-02-12)

fact_text: Some listed companies have had their equity pushed toward negative; the analyst notes sponsors can inject capital to restore positive equity, which he sees as a positive sign.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SAZGAR ROE Analysis Reveals the SECRET to MAXIMIZING Return on Equity | Afaque Manzar | #psx' (YouTube, 2025-02-12)

fact_text: The analyst said Pakistan's stock market has more than 500 listed companies, of which only some are profitable.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'SAZGAR ROE Analysis Reveals the SECRET to MAXIMIZING Return on Equity | Afaque Manzar | #psx' (YouTube, 2025-02-12)
